have.what_it_gives: request_type = price_pressure. SECONDARY = retention_or_loyalty, capped at ≤20% of slots. Business objective: by 2026-11-15, weekly WhatsApp bookings at unchanged prices return to the pre-campaign baseline (conservative), +10% (expected) or +20% (stretch). Constraints: no price cuts; no comparisons or competitors; hands and voice only until consent; no prices until in the ledger. Guardrails: first reply ≤15 min, chat→booking rate ≥ baseline, 2GIS rating not below current. Three clarifying questions are queued: who leaves, who may be filmed, where to steer bookings. Bottleneck hypothesis: consideration/conversion after the price is sent, ~30% confidence. REALISM ratio 0.6–5.9; every input is an assumption.

have.input: Client profile (HYPOTHETICAL; every field is an assumption)
have.what_it_gives: Vertical beauty_salon, Шымкент, RU/KK. Mid-price, '8 masters' (unverified). Sales channels: WhatsApp booking, 2GIS, walk-in. Owner perception: nearby salons are ~30% cheaper (internal context only, never in content). Owner reports good 2GIS reviews (unverified). Staff: 20 min/week, one phone, audio usable only close up. Known unknowns: exact prices, which services lose clients, masters' consent. Instagram is 'unknown'; TikTok is not mentioned.

Zero usable facts. No price, number, hours, address, rating, review count, service list, policy or capability may appear in any audience string yet. Every such idea carries a NEEDS FACT until an agent fetch or an owner input fills the ledger.

have.input: Knowledge base learnings L001, L003, L005, L006
have.what_it_gives: L001 (measured): the text judge scores Shorts at Spearman 0.11 (0.07 retail, CI includes 0, n=1172), so rubric scores are priors only and the batch must be wide and cheap. L003 (measured): long-form title tricks ('для начинающих', 'vs') have median relative views of 1.00/0.99 on Shorts, so no hook formula is assumed. L005 (expert judgment): price slides are useless, so why_it_costs must be shown with hands, sound and process, never as a price card; this matters a lot for a price_pressure brief. L006 (measured, correlational): demos with no buyer question underperform (390 vs 2,300 median, n=48), so every process clip is tied to a client question or doubt. There are no beauty_salon-specific pooled priors and no graveyard entries.

missing.input: Own footprint fetch: 2GIS card, Instagram/TikTok/YouTube search, website if any

It gives the service list, any published prices (dated), hours, address, rating and review count, and any published offers. It also tests the assumption of no medical-cosmetic services (REGULATED). It confirms whether Instagram or TikTok exists, and the last 15 posts give the account median and its ≥3× outliers. Hygiene errors are flagged and never repeated.

If found, pull the last 15 posts with views/likes/comments, compute views ÷ median, and list outliers and posts whose comments ask questions. On 403/429, log it and don't bypass. Ask for a screenshot only if a step is blocked. NOTE: the client is hypothetical, so the fetch may find nothing; then everything stays an assumption.
missing.fallback_if_missing: The ledger stays empty and content runs on recognition, question and process ideas with no claims. Account median = pooled beauty_salon median. Account existence becomes part of the owner's account ask.

They reveal the category conventions to break (e.g. a finished-nails photo with music, or a 'было/стало' with no process). Questions from peer comments substitute for missing chat data. All findings are hypotheses, not winners.

These are reasons to book now that need no discount.

missing.input: WhatsApp chat export: 15–30 recent client chats, without media

It shows where chats die (after the price? after «подумаю»? after a slow reply?), the median first reply, the close rate, weekly inquiries (the baseline the targets hang on), the exact objection wording («дорого», «а там дешевле», «а мастер Х ещё работает?»), and which services are asked about and lost. If reply time or scripts are the leak, push_back shifts to fixing the WhatsApp layer before content.

Чтобы понять, где теряются клиенты, пришлите, пожалуйста, переписки: откройте чат с клиентом → ⋮ (или имя контакта) → „Экспорт чата“ → „Без медиафайлов“. Нужно 15–30 последних чатов с новыми клиентами, особенно с теми, кто спросил цену и не записался. Имена и номера удаляем сразу, наружу ничего не попадает. До 12.10.»

По умолчанию: 1. (2) Кого можно снимать? 1 — только руки мастеров и голос; 2 — мастеров с лицом (кто согласен); 3 — и клиентов (с их согласия). По умолчанию: 1. (3) Куда звать новых? 1 — будни днём; 2 — к мастерам/услугам, где есть окна (каким?); 3 — почти всё свободно. По умолчанию: 1. (4) Цены в роликах: 1 — можно, по прайсу; 2 — нельзя. По умолчанию: 2. Ответ до 10.10 12:00, иначе работаем по умолчанию.»
